name: Four Seasons Resort Maldives at Kuda Huraa
positioning: Island resort on North Malé Atoll in the Maldives, a speed-boat ride from Malé International Airport, with beach and overwater villas
best_for: Travelers who want a short speed-boat transfer from Malé International Airport
Guests who want to surf, dive or take dolphin cruises
Families who want a kids' club

facts.text: The resort is located on North Malé Atoll.
The resort is a 25-minute speedboat ride from Malé International Airport.
Transfers to Kuda Huraa are exclusively by speed-boat.
Baraabaru is a lagoon-top Indian restaurant.
Reef Club is an Italian beachside restaurant.
The ŪRJĀ Naturopathy Island spa is on its own island, reached by a two-minute boat ride.
The resort was honoured with a sixth consecutive Forbes 5-Star rating in 2026.

highlights.text: The Sunset Water Villa with Pool lets guests dive from the bedroom straight into the infinity pool.
Tropicsurf pros run surf classes and courses for guests aged six and above.
The dolphin cruise sails on a traditional dhoni boat with a marine biologist.
The Night Spa Ritual is reserved exclusively for one individual or couple each night.
The Water Sports Centre provides complimentary snorkels, masks, fins and kayaks.
The Kuda Koamas Kids' Club has supervised activities indoors and outdoors.

considerations.text: Kite surfing is not permitted in the resort lagoon.
Flying a drone on the island is limited to a restricted area and requires the supervision of resort staff.
The dolphin cruise is from USD 110 per person.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
